title: Tracking of Mental Health and Stress Levels of Students with Roll-out of Subject-Based Banding
what_it_is: Tracking of Mental Health and Stress Levels of Students with Roll-out of Subject-Based Banding

sections.label: Full SBB pilot monitoring
sections.summary: MOE monitors the Full SBB pilot in 28 secondary schools, with first-year findings showing more diverse friendships and growth mindsets.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Education (MOE) works closely with the 28 secondary schools piloting Full Subject-Based Banding, or Full SBB, in all aspects of the implementation, including the socio-emotional development and the well-being of our students.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: The pilot has started last year and we are monitoring the implementation closely.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Feedback is collected through surveys and focus group discussions with students and teachers so that we know how Full SBB is impacting student well-being, social and learning experiences and outcomes.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Findings from the first year of implementation indicate that students in the pilot schools have a more diverse network of friends drawn from across the different courses, compared to schools that have yet to implement Full SBB.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: They form stronger friendships based on common interests and treat their peers with respect regardless of course.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: It is early days yet, but there are also indications of more students adopting growth mindsets.

sections.label: Multiple pathways to success
sections.summary: MOE promotes multiple pathways to success, encouraging society to broaden its view of success and ease academic stress.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: MOE has been promoting the concept of multiple pathways to success and not just in relation to Full SBB.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: I think we heard the response from Minister Maliki earlier as well.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: There is a continuous conversation and continuous encouragement to society – parents, stakeholders and community partners alike – to expand the way we look at success and acknowledge multiple pathways of success.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: And this is to help our students develop a growth mindset and also alleviate any mental well-being concerns that may arise from academic stress.
